title: Ford: reasons, alerts, PeopleLeft and the save version in the engine
why: Open 0, New 1, Miss 1, Importance 1, Reach 2 = 5: haiku high. Every field, rule, threshold, text and test is in the spec; merge4's note is the pattern it adapts; the digest test and bench catch a slip; notes are written in every turn's steps. It touches many rule files, but each change is one call where the rule already decides. This is the piece's Haiku step. Part and score agree: a ford well under 12.

title: Ford: reasons, alerts, holders, routes, line and hidden country on the page; archive merge4
why: Open 2, New 1, Miss 1, Importance 0, Reach 1 = 5, haiku high on the ladder. Settled panel and map work in the page's own patterns, part of it judged by eye from screenshots, with a play script it must write as the test. Off the ladder up to sonnet medium: it spans five page files (canvas drawing in a 1165-line map-view.js, the feed, panels, menus) plus a headless-Chrome script that has to drive a camp into an alert and a file-input load. I expect Sonnet to finish in one attempt with play-read.mjs passing and screenshots that read cleanly, where Haiku would likely need a second attempt on the play script or leave the map too busy. The retro can check that. Part and score agree.

title: Review the piece
why: Open 2, New 1, Miss 3, Importance 1, Reach 2 = 9: by coin, opus low.
